    if (amount == 0) revert NoClaimableBalance(workflowId, _msgSender(), token);\n\n        claimableBalances[workflowId][_msgSender()] = 0;\n        totalClaimableAssets[token] -= amount;\n\n        _transferTokens(token, _msgSender(), amount);\n\n        emit EscrowWithdrawn(workflowId, _msgSender(), token, amount);\n        return amount;\n    }\n\n\n    function _validateWorkflowId(uint256 workflowId) internal view {\n        if (workflowId >= escrowTransfers.length) {\n            revert InvalidWorkflowId(workflowId, escrowTransfers.length);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Get the total number of escrows created\n     * @return count Total number of escrows\n     * @dev Added for EscrowViewContract to check bounds without reverting\n     */\n    function getEscrowCount() external view returns (uint256 count) {\n        return escrowTransfers.length;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Check if release is allowed - simplified for size\n    function canRelease(uint256 workflowId, address caller) external view returns (bool allowed) {\n        if (workflowId >= escrowTransfers.length) return false;\n        EscrowTransfer storage et = escrowTransfers[workflowId];\n        if (et.escrowState != EscrowState.PENDING) return false;\n        if (caller != et.from) return false;\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Stub for backwards compatibility - returns state directly\n    function getEscrowState(uint256 workflowId) external view returns (EscrowState state) {\n        _validateWorkflowId(workflowId);\n        return escrowTransfers[workflowId].escrowState;\n    }\n\n    // View functions moved to EscrowViewContract for size optimization:\n    // - getResolutionMode() \n    // - getActiveDisputeHandler()\n    // - canRelease()\n    // - getActionStatus()\n\n    function _requirePending(uint256 workflowId) internal view {\n        _validateWorkflowId(workflowId);\n        EscrowState st = escrowTransfers[workflowId].escrowState;\n        if (st != EscrowState.PENDING) {\n            revert TransferNotPending(workflowId, st);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Attempt automatic transfer with graceful fallback to claimable balance\n     * @param workflowId The escrow ID\n     * @param recipient Address to receive funds\n     * @param token Token address\n     * @param amount Amount to transfer\n     * @param principalExpected Expected principal (for validating yield claims)\n     * @return transferred True if transfer succeeded, false if fell back to claimable\n     */\n    function _attemptAutoTransfer(\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        address recipient,\n        address token,\n        uint256 amount,\n        uint256 principalExpected\n    ) internal returns (bool transferred) {\n        if (amount == 0) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        uint256 bal = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));\n        \n        // CRITICAL: If module claims yield (amount > principal), escrow MUST have the funds\n        // Otherwise the module overreported and we must revert to prevent fund loss\n        if (amount > principalExpected) {\n            require(bal >= amount, \"EscrowInsufficientBalance\");\n        }\n        \n        // If amount <= principalExpected, it's OK to fallback to claimable if transfer fails\n        bool success = bal >= amount && _tryTransfer(token, recipient, amount);\n        if (success) {\n            emit EscrowTransferAutoResult(workflowId, recipient, token, amount, true, 0);\n            return true;\n        }\n        \n        // Transfer failed - set as claimable\n        claimableBalances[workflowId][recipient] += amount;\n        totalClaimableAssets[token] += amount;\n        emit ClaimableBalanceSet(workflowId, recipient, token, amount);\n        uint8 reason = bal < amount ? uint8(FailureReason.CONTRACT_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE) : uint8(FailureReason.PUSH_FAILED_FALLBACK_TO_PULL);\n        emit EscrowTransferAutoResult(workflowId, recipient, token, amount, false, reason);\n        emit OperationFailure(4, workflowId, token, IERC20.transfer.selector, reason);\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    function _tryTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal returns (bool success) {\n        (success, ) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transfer.selector, to, amount));\n        if (success) {\n            assembly {\n                if returndatasize() {\n                    returndatacopy(0, 0, returndatasize())\n                    success := and(mload(0), 0xff)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Handle v2.5 yield module unwind on release/cancel\n     * @dev If no module or no initialized yield, returns original amount\n     * @dev Otherwise delegates to module for unwind (which handles all recovery)\n     * @dev If unwind reverts, tries emergencyUnwind as fallback\n     */\n    function _handleYieldModuleUnwind(\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        address token,\n        uint256 amount\n    ) internal virtual returns (uint256 principalOut, uint256 yieldOut) {\n        address module = v25YieldModules[workflowId];\n        if (module == address(0)) return (amount, 0);\n        \n        uint256 yieldPrincipal = v25YieldPrincipals[workflowId];\n        if (yieldPrincipal == 0) return (amount, 0);\n        \n        // Try normal unwind first\n        try IYieldModule(module).unwindToEscrow(workflowId, token, yieldPrincipal) returns (uint256 principal, uint256 yield) {\n            return (principal, yield);\n        } catch {\n            // Unwind failed - try emergency unwind\n            try IYieldModule(module).emergencyUnwind(workflowId, token, yieldPrincipal) returns (uint256 recovered) {\n                // INVARIANT: Reject partial recovery - must recover full principal or revert\n                if (recovered < yieldPrincipal) {\n                    revert(\"YieldModuleEmergency: PartialRecoveryNotAllowed\");\n                }\n                return (recovered, 0);\n            } catch {\n                // Emergency unwind also failed - return original amount as fallback\n                return (yieldPrincipal, 0);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _cancelAndRefund(uint256 workflowId) internal {\n        EscrowTransfer storage et = escrowTransfers[workflowId];\n        uint256 amount = et.amountAfterFee;\n        address from = et.from;\n        address token = et.token;\n\n        if (pendingSettlements[workflowId].exists) {\n            delete pendingSettlements[workflowId];\n            emit PendingSettlementCancelled(workflowId);\n        }\n\n        EscrowState oldStatus = StateManagementLibrary.transitionToRefunded(et, workflowId);\n        emit EscrowStateChanged(workflowId, oldStatus, EscrowState.REFUNDED);\n        \n        (uint256 principal, uint256 yield) = _handleYieldModuleUnwind(workflowId, token, amount);\n        uint256 actualAmount = principal + yield;\n        \n        // CRITICAL: Update accounting based on FULL principal amount (amount, not principal)\n        // When module has loss: principal < amount\n        // The loss difference appears as \"unaccounted\" in the balance delta\n        // This makes losses visible in accounting for operators to detect and track\n        _updateEscrowBalance(token, amount, false);\n        \n        // Auto-transfer: Attempt automatic transfer, fallback to claimable if fails\n        _attemptAutoTransfer(workflowId, from, token, actualAmount, amount);\n        _emitEscrowTransferCancelled(workflowId, token, from, amount);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Best-effort check if strategy allows release (used by getActionStatus)\n     * @dev Uses staticcall to safely query strategy without reverting\n     * @return canRelease True if strategy returns allowed=true, false if call fails or not allowed\n     */\n    function _checkStrategyCanRelease(uint256 workflowId, EscrowTransfer storage et) internal view returns (bool canRelease) {\n        IReleaseStrategy strategy = _getReleaseStrategy(workflowId);\n        if (address(strategy) == address(0)) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        try this._staticCanRelease(\n            workflowId,\n            et.token,\n            et.from,\n            et.to,\n            et.amountAfterFee\n        ) returns (bool allowed) {\n            return allowed;\n        } catch {\n            // If strategy call fails, report as unavailable (safe default for UI)\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Wrapper for staticcall to strategy (internal helper for getActionStatus)\n     * @dev Takes individual escrow fields instead of storage pointer (required for external function)\n     */\n    function _staticCanRelease(\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        address token,\n        address sender,\n        address recipient,\n        uint256 amountAfterFee\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\n        IReleaseStrategy strategy = _getReleaseStrategy(workflowId);\n        if (address(strategy) == address(0)) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Get releaseAddress from escrow settings\n        address releaseAddr = escrowSettings[workflowId].releaseAddress;\n\n        bytes memory escrowData = EscrowEncodingLibrary.encodeEscrowTransferData(\n            token,\n            sender,\n            recipient,\n            amountAfterFee,\n            releaseAddr\n        );\n\n        (bool allowed, ) = strategy.canRelease(workflowId, address(this), _msgSender(), escrowData);\n        return allowed;\n    }\n\n    function _releaseEscrowTransfer(uint256 workflowId) internal {\n        EscrowTransfer storage et = escrowTransfers[workflowId];\n        uint256 amount = et.amountAfterFee;\n        address to = et.to;\n        address token = et.token;\n\n        if (pendingSettlements[workflowId].exists) {\n            delete pendingSettlements[workflowId];\n            emit PendingSettlementCancelled(workflowId);\n        }\n\n        EscrowState oldStatus = StateManagementLibrary.transitionToReleased(et, workflowId);\n        emit EscrowStateChanged(workflowId, oldStatus, EscrowState.RELEASED);\n        \n        (uint256 principal, uint256 yield) = _handleYieldModuleUnwind(workflowId, token, amount);\n        uint256 actualAmount = principal + yield;\n        \n        // CRITICAL: Update accounting based on FULL principal amount (amount, not principal)\n        // When module has loss: principal < amount\n        // Example: amount=990e18, principal=890e18 (loss=100e18)\n        // We reduce totalHeldInEscrowPerToken by 990e18 (full amount)\n        // But only transfer out 890e18\n        // The 100e18 difference appears as \"unaccounted\" in the balance delta\n        // This makes losses visible in accounting: contractBalance - expected = loss\n        _updateEscrowBalance(token, amount, false);\n        \n        // Auto-transfer: Attempt automatic transfer, fallback to claimable if fails\n        _attemptAutoTransfer(workflowId, to, token, actualAmount, amount);\n        _emitEscrowTransferReleased(workflowId, token, to, amount);\n    }\n\n    function _transferTokens(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual;\n    function _updateEscrowBalance(address token, uint256 amount, bool add) internal virtual;\n    function _emitEscrowTransferCancelled(\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        address token,\n        address from,\n        uint256 amount\n    ) internal virtual;\n    function _emitEscrowTransferReleased(\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        address token,\n        address to,\n        uint256 amount\n    ) internal virtual;\n    function _getYieldGenerationModule(\n        uint256 workflowId\n    ) internal view virtual returns (IYieldModule);\n    function _getYieldDistributionModule(\n        uint256 workflowId\n    ) internal view virtual returns (IYieldDistributionModule);\n    function _getReleaseStrategy(\n        uint256 workflowId\n    ) internal view virtual returns (IReleaseStrategy);\n    function _getResolutionModule(\n        uint256 workflowId\n    ) internal view virtual returns (IResolutionModule) {\n        address snap = moduleSnapshots[workflowId].resolutionModule;\n        if (snap != address(0)) {\n            return IResolutionModule(snap);\n        }\n        return IResolutionModule(disputeResolutionModule);\n    }\n\n    function _depositYieldForEscrow(uint256 workflowId, address token, uint256 amount) internal virtual {\n        IYieldModule genModule = _getYieldGenerationModule(workflowId);\n        if (address(genModule) != address(0)) {\n            (bool supported, ) = genModule.canHandle(token, YieldPreset.OFF, amount);\n            if (supported) {\n                // Call _depositForYield which is overridden in child contracts (EscrowVault/EscrowableERC20)\n                // This allows child contracts to set approvals before calling the module\n                _depositForYield(genModule, workflowId, token, amount);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ResolutionOutcome enum removed - using version from EscrowTypes.sol\n\n    function _recordResolutionOutcome(\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        address disputeResolver,\n        bool isRelease,\n = isRelease\n            ? ResolutionOutcome.RELEASE\n            : ResolutionOutcome.CANCEL;\n        uint256 resolutionTime = block.timestamp;\n        (bool success, ) = module.call(\n            abi.encodeWithSelector(\n                SEL_RECORD_RESOLUTION,\n                workflowId,\n                address(this),\n                disputeResolver,\n                uint8(outcome),\n                resolutionTime\n            )\n        );\n        success;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x40be2bf5733d1b3a2ee92fd9a8dd05cee8fba9f189d7c5c7d90886a8eefb7543","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/core/BondCollector.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\npragma solidity ^0.8.33;\n\nimport '@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol';\nimport '@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol';\nimport '@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol';\nimport '../shared/interfaces/IIncentiveModule.sol';\nimport '../types/EscrowTypes.sol';\n\n/**\n * @title BondCollector\n * @notice External contract for collecting escalation bonds (ETH or ERC20)\n * @dev Extracted from BaseEscrow to reduce contract size (Priority 2 optimization)\n * \n *      Handles:\n *      - ETH bond collection with protocol fee deduction\n *      - ERC20 bond collection with protocol fee deduction\n *      - Custody lives in this contract for ERC20 bonds (escrow transfers in, this contract approves incentive module)\n *      - Protocol fee transfer to fee address\n *      - Bond recording via incentive module\n */\ncontract BondCollector is AccessControl {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    // ============ Role Constants ============\n    bytes32 public constant ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT = keccak256('ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT');\n    bytes32 public constant ROLE_TIMELOCK = keccak256('ROLE_TIMELOCK');\n    \n    // ============ Custom Errors ============\n    error ZeroOwner();\n\n    // Events\n    event ProtocolFeeCollected(\n        uint8 indexed kind, // 1 = appeal bond\n        uint256 indexed workflowId,\n        address indexed token,\n        uint256 bondAmount,\n        uint256 feeBps,\n        uint256 feeAmount\n    );\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Constructor for BondCollector\n     * @param initialOwner Address that will receive DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (for initial setup only)\n     */\n    constructor(address initialOwner) {\n        if (initialOwner == address(0)) revert ZeroOwner();\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, initialOwner);\n        // ROLE_TIMELOCK gates registerEscrowContract(), so initialOwner must have it for initial setup.\n        _grantRole(ROLE_TIMELOCK, initialOwner);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Register an escrow contract (grants it ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT)\n     * @param escrowContract Address of the escrow contract\n     * @dev Only ROLE_TIMELOCK can register escrow contracts (governance-controlled)\n     */\n    function registerEscrowContract(address escrowContract) external onlyRole(ROLE_TIMELOCK) {\n        if (escrowContract == address(0)) revert InvalidAddress(ADDR_ESCROW_CONTRACT, escrowContract);\n        _grantRole(ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT, escrowContract);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Collect escalation bond (ETH or ERC20) and deduct protocol fee\n     * @param workflowId The escrow ID\n     * @param incentiveMod Incentive module for bond recording\n     * @param bondAmount Bond amount to collect\n     * @param bondToken Bond token address (address(0) for ETH)\n     * @param newLevel New escalation level\n     * @param snapshottedBondFee Protocol fee in basis points (from module snapshot)\n     * @param escrowFeeAddress Address to receive protocol fees\n     * @param depositor Address that deposited the bond (user for ETH, this contract for ERC20)\n     * @param escalatedBy Address that initiated the escalation (always the user)\n     * @return collected Whether bond was successfully collected\n     * @dev Only authorized escrow contracts can call this function\n     */\n    function collectBond(\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        IIncentiveModule incentiveMod,\n        uint256 bondAmount,\n        address bondToken,\n        uint8 newLevel,\n        uint256 snapshottedBondFee,\n        address escrowFeeAddress,\n        address depositor,\n        address escalatedBy\n    ) external payable onlyRole(ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT) returns (bool collected) {\n        if (address(incentiveMod) == address(0)) return false;\n        \n        if (bondToken == address(0)) {\n            return _collectETHBond(workflowId, incentiveMod, bondAmount, newLevel, snapshottedBondFee, escrowFeeAddress, depositor, escalatedBy);\n        } else {\n            return _collectERC20Bond(workflowId, incentiveMod, bondAmount, bondToken, newLevel, snapshottedBondFee, escrowFeeAddress, depositor, escalatedBy);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Internal function to handle ETH bond collection\n     */\n    function _collectETHBond(\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        IIncentiveModule incentiveMod,\n        uint256 bondAmount,\n        uint8 newLevel,\n        uint256 snapshottedBondFee,\n        address escrowFeeAddress,\n        address depositor,\n        address escalatedBy\n    ) internal returns (bool) {\n        uint256 ethToSend = bondAmount;\n        if (msg.value > bondAmount) {\n            ethToSend = bondAmount;\n        }\n        \n        if (snapshottedBondFee > 0 && escrowFeeAddress != address(0)) {\n            uint256 protocolFeeAmount = (ethToSend * snapshottedBondFee) / 10000;\n            if (protocolFeeAmount > 0) {\n                (bool feeSuccess, ) = payable(escrowFeeAddress).call{value: protocolFeeAmount}('');\n                if (!feeSuccess) return false;\n                ethToSend = ethToSend - protocolFeeAmount;\n                emit ProtocolFeeCollected(1, workflowId, address(0), bondAmount, snapshottedBondFee, protocolFeeAmount);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (ethToSend > 0) {\n            return _recordETHBond(workflowId, incentiveMod, ethToSend, newLevel, depositor, escalatedBy);\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    function _recordETHBond(\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        IIncentiveModule incentiveMod,\n        uint256 ethToSend,\n        uint8 newLevel,\n        address depositor,\n        address escalatedBy\n    ) internal returns (bool) {\n        (bool s, ) = address(incentiveMod).call{value: ethToSend}(\n            abi.encodeWithSelector(\n                IIncentiveModule.recordAppealBond.selector,\n                workflowId,\n                _msgSender(),\n                depositor,\n                escalatedBy,\n                ethToSend,\n                address(0),\n                newLevel\n            )\n        );\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Internal function to handle ERC20 bond collection\n     */\n    function _collectERC20Bond(\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        IIncentiveModule incentiveMod,\n        uint256 bondAmount,\n        address bondToken,\n        uint8 newLevel,\n        uint256 snapshottedBondFee,\n        address escrowFeeAddress,\n        address depositor,\n        address escalatedBy\n    ) internal returns (bool) {\n        // CRIT-3: Actually pull the tokens from the caller\n        IERC20(bondToken).safeTransferFrom(_msgSender(), address(this), bondAmount);\n\n        uint256 bondToRecord = bondAmount;\n        \n        if (snapshottedBondFee > 0 && escrowFeeAddress != address(0)) {\n            uint256 protocolFeeAmount = (bondAmount * snapshottedBondFee) / 10000;\n            if (protocolFeeAmount > 0) {\n                bondToRecord = bondAmount - protocolFeeAmount;\n                IERC20(bondToken).safeTransfer(escrowFeeAddress, protocolFeeAmount);\n                emit ProtocolFeeCollected(1, workflowId, bondToken, bondAmount, snapshottedBondFee, protocolFeeAmount);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (bondToRecord > 0) {\n            IERC20(bondToken).safeIncreaseAllowance(address(incentiveMod), bondToRecord);\n            try incentiveMod.recordAppealBond(workflowId, _msgSender(), depositor, escalatedBy, bondToRecord, bondToken, newLevel) {\n                IERC20(bondToken).approve(address(incentiveMod), 0);\n                return true;\n            } catch {\n                IERC20(bondToken).approve(address(incentiveMod), 0);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Approve a spender to pull ERC20 bond tokens\n     * @dev Intended for escrow contract flows where the escrow contract calls the incentive module,\n     *      but custody lives in this contract (BondCollector).\n     */\n    function approveBondSpender(\n        address token,\n        address spender,\n        uint256 amount\n    ) external onlyRole(ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT) {\n        IERC20(token).safeIncreaseAllowance(spender, amount);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Reset an ERC20 approval back to zero\n     * @dev Best practice to avoid leaving allowances lingering on third-party contracts.\n     */\n    function resetBondSpender(address token, address spender) external onlyRole(ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT) {\n        IERC20(token).approve(spender, 0);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Recover ERC20 tokens sent to this contract by mistake\n     */\n    function recoverERC20(\n        address token,\n        address recipient,\n        uint256 amount\n    ) external onlyRole(ROLE_TIMELOCK) {\n        uint256 balance = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));\n        uint256 recoveryAmount = amount == 0 ? balance : amount;\n        if (recoveryAmount > balance) revert InvalidAmount(AMOUNT_GENERIC);\n        IERC20(token).safeTransfer(recipient, recoveryAmount);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Recover native ETH sent to this contract by mistake\n     */\n    function recoverNativeETH(\n        address recipient,\n        uint256 amount\n    ) external onlyRole(ROLE_TIMELOCK) {\n        uint256 balance = address(this).balance;\n        uint256 recoveryAmount = amount == 0 ? balance : amount;\n        if (recoveryAmount > balance) revert InvalidAmount(AMOUNT_GENERIC);\n        (bool success, ) = payable(recipient).call{value: recoveryAmount}(\"\");\n        if (!success) revert InvalidAddress(ADDR_RECIPIENT, recipient);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x08a5f5131c9a1aaeeede32eb86be5314c30cf0906854b453dddd2e31625707f2","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/governance/SlowLaneQueueActivate.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\npragma solidity ^0.8.33;\n\n/**\n * @title SlowLaneQueueActivate\n * @notice Abstract contract providing two-step queue/activate pattern for Slow lane governance\n * @dev Enforces 7-day delay for high-risk changes (module swaps, fee recipient, etc.)\n *\n * Usage:\n * 1. Inherit this contract\n * 2. Add storage for pending values (PendingAddress or PendingUint)\n * 3. Implement queueX() function calling _queueAddress() or _queueUint()\n * 4. Implement activateX() function calling _activateAddress() or _activateUint()\n *\n * Pattern:\n * - queueX() stores pending value and ETA (now + 7 days)\n * - activateX() checks ETA has passed, then applies the change\n * - This enforces 7-day delay on top of Timelock's 48h delay\n *\n * Example:\n * ```solidity\n * PendingAddress private _pendingFeeRecipient;\n *\n * function queueFeeRecipient(address newAddr) external onlyRole(ROLE_TIMELOCK) {\n *     _queueAddress(_pendingFeeRecipient, newAddr);\n *     emit FeeRecipientQueued(feeRecipient, newAddr, _pendingFeeRecipient.eta);\n * }\n *\n * function activateFeeRecipient() external onlyRole(ROLE_TIMELOCK) {\n *     address old = feeRecipient;\n *     feeRecipient = _activateAddress(_pendingFeeRecipient);\n *     emit FeeRecipientActivated(old, feeRecipient);\n * }\n * ```\n */\nabstract contract SlowLaneQueueActivate {\n    /// @notice Slow lane delay: 7 days\n    uint256 public constant SLOW_DELAY = 7 days;\n\n    /// @notice Pending address change with ETA\n    struct PendingAddress {\n        address value;\n        uint64 eta; // Unix timestamp when activation is allowed\n        bool exists;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pending uint256 change with ETA\n    struct PendingUint {\n        uint256 value;\n        uint64 eta; // Unix timestamp when activation is allowed\n        bool exists;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Error thrown when trying to activate before ETA\n    error NotReady(uint64 eta);\n\n    /// @notice Error thrown when no pending change exists\n    error NoPending();\n\n    /// @notice Error thrown when value is invalid (e.g., zero address)\n    error InvalidValue();\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Queue an address change\n     * @param pending Storage reference to PendingAddress\n     * @param newValue New address value to queue\n     * @dev Sets pending value and ETA = now + SLOW_DELAY\n     */\n    function _queueAddress(PendingAddress storage pending, address newValue) internal {\n        if (newValue == address(0)) {\n            revert InvalidValue();\n        }\n        pending.value = newValue;\n        pending.eta = uint64(block.timestamp + SLOW_DELAY); // forge-lint: disable-line(unsafe-typecast)\n        pending.exists = true;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Activate a queued address change\n     * @param pending Storage reference to PendingAddress\n     * @return activatedValue The activated address value\n     * @dev Reverts if no pending change or ETA not reached\n     */\n    function _activateAddress(PendingAddress storage pending) internal returns (address) {\n        if (!pending.exists) {\n            revert NoPending();\n        }\n        if (block.timestamp < pending.eta) {\n            revert NotReady(pending.eta);\n        }\n        address value = pending.value;\n        // Clear all fields\n        pending.value = address(0);\n        pending.eta = 0;\n        pending.exists = false;\n        return value;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Queue a uint256 change\n     * @param pending Storage reference to PendingUint\n     * @param newValue New uint256 value to queue\n     * @dev Sets pending value and ETA = now + SLOW_DELAY\n     */\n    function _queueUint(PendingUint storage pending, uint256 newValue) internal {\n        pending.value = newValue;\n        pending.eta = uint64(block.timestamp + SLOW_DELAY); // forge-lint: disable-line(unsafe-typecast)\n        pending.exists = true;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Activate a queued uint256 change\n     * @param pending Storage reference to PendingUint\n     * @return activatedValue The activated uint256 value\n     * @dev Reverts if no pending change or ETA not reached\n     */\n    function _activateUint(PendingUint storage pending) internal returns (uint256) {\n        if (!pending.exists) {\n            revert NoPending();\n        }\n        if (block.timestamp < SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\npragma solidity ^0.8.33;\n\nimport '../types/YieldPresets.sol';\n\n/**\n * @title IYieldModule\n * @notice Unified interface for yield generation modules\n * \n * DESIGN PRINCIPLE: Modules are responsible for yield generation mechanics\n * (deposit, track, withdraw). Escrows are responsible for distribution policy\n * (who gets principal, how yield splits, fee routing).\n * \n * This separation ensures:\n * - Policy consistency (one source of truth in core)\n * - Module simplicity (just protocol integration)\n * - Fund safety (clear invariants)\n * - Easy extensibility (add protocols without touching core)\n * \n * FUND FLOW INVARIANT:\n * 1. Escrow transfers principal to module\n * 2. Module deposits into protocol (Aave, Morpho, etc.)\n * 3. Module tracks positions by (caller/escrow, escrowId)\n * 4. On unwind: module withdraws to escrow\n * 5. Module NEVER sends funds to arbitrary recipients\n * 6. Module ONLY returns funds to msg.sender (the escrow)\n * \n * AUTHORIZATION INVARIANT:\n * - Module checks msg.sender is an approved escrow\n * - Module state is namespaced by (msg.sender, escrowId)\n * - This prevents griefing and state collisions\n * \n * SAFETY INVARIANTS:\n * - INVARIANT 1: No silent fund loss (emergency recovery required, revert if impossible)\n * - INVARIANT 2: Module cannot redirect funds (onlyEscrow gating, state namespacing)\n * - INVARIANT 3: Distribution policy is canonical (in core, not module)\n * - INVARIANT 4: Principal accounting correct (store accepted amount, not requested)\n * - INVARIANT 5: Balance verification provable (delta check, not absolute)\n * - INVARIANT 6: emergencyUnwind strict semantics (return > 0 or revert, never 0)\n */\ninterface IYieldModule {\n    \n    // ============ Core Operations ============\n    \n    /**\n     * @notice Initialize yield position\n     * @param escrowId Unique escrow identifier\n     * @param token Token to yield on\n     * @param amount Amount to deposit\n     * @param yieldMode Preset (OFF, TO_SENDER, TO_RECIPIENT, etc.)\n     * @return accepted Amount actually accepted for yielding\n     * \n     * @dev Called once per escrow during initialization\n     * @dev Escrow transfers 'amount' to this contract before calling\n     * @dev State stored namespaced by (msg.sender, escrowId)\n     * @dev Must revert if cannot accept this token/amount\n     * @dev Returns 'accepted' which may differ from 'amount' due to:\n     *      - Fee-on-transfer tokens (accepted < amount)\n     *      - Rebasing tokens (tracks units deposited)\n     *      - Protocol limits (min/max constraints)\n     * \n     * INVARIANT 4: Store accepted amount for yield calculation\n     *      This is the basis for future principal/yield split\n     */\n    function initializeYield(\n        uint256 escrowId,\n        address token,\n        uint256 amount,\n        YieldPreset yieldMode\n    ) external returns (uint256 accepted);\n    \n    /**\n     * @notice Withdraw yield position back to escrow\n     * @param escrowId Escrow identifier\n     * @param token Token address\n     * @param principalExpected Expected principal (for validation)\n     * @return principalOut Actual principal withdrawn\n     * @return yieldOut Gross yield accrued (may be 0)\n     * \n     * @dev Called during escrow release/cancellation\n     * @dev Returns funds to msg.sender (the escrow contract)\n     * @dev On failure: escrow will attempt emergencyUnwind\n     * @dev Must preserve invariant: only send to msg.sender\n     * @dev principalOut should match initializeYield's accepted amount\n     *      yieldOut = total_withdrawn - principalOut\n     */\n    function unwindToEscrow(\n        uint256 escrowId,\n        address token,\n        uint256 principalExpected\n    ) external returns (uint256 principalOut, uint256 yieldOut);\n    \n    /**\n     * @notice Emergency recovery path\n     * @param escrowId Escrow identifier\n     * @param token Token address\n     * @param principalExpected Expected principal\n     * @return recovered Amount recovered (always > 0, or reverts)\n     * \n     * @dev Called after unwindToEscrow fails\n     * @dev INVARIANT 6: MUST return funds or REVERT (never return 0)\n     *      Strict semantics: return > 0 or fail\n     *      No ambiguous \"I tried and got nothing\" states\n     * @dev Returns funds to msg.sender only\n     * @dev INVARIANT 1: MUST NOT silently abandon yield (emit event if needed)\n     * @dev Best-effort recovery; if any recovery is possible, return it\n     *      If recovery is impossible, revert with clear reason\n     */\n    function emergencyUnwind(\n        uint256 escrowId,\n        address token,\n        uint256 principalExpected\n    ) external returns (uint256 recovered);\n    \n    // ============ Metadata & Validation ============\n    \n    /**\n     * @notice Check if module can handle this token/amount\n     * @param token Token address\n     * @param mode Yield mode\n     * @param amount Amount to deposit\n     * @return supported Whether supported\n     * @return reasonCode Error code if not (0x0 = OK, else specific reason)\n     * \n     * @dev Used for preflight checks; initializeYield may still revert\n     * @dev Reason codes: 0x0 (OK), 0x1 (token not supported), etc.\n     * @dev Not safety-critical; initializeYield is the authoritative check\n     */\n    function canHandle(\n        address token,\n        YieldPreset mode,\n        uint256 amount\n    ) external view returns (bool supported, bytes32 reasonCode);\n    \n    /**\n     * @notice Get module metadata\n     * @return name Module name (e.g., \"AaveYieldModule\")\n     * @return version Version (e.g., \"1.0.0\")\n     * @return protocolId Unique ID (e.g., keccak256(\"aave-v3\"))\n     */\n    function getModuleInfo()\n        external view returns (string memory name, string memory version, bytes32 protocolId);\n    \n    // ============ Events ============\n    \n    /**\n     * @notice Emitted when yield is initialized\n     * @param escrowId The escrow identifier\n     * @param token The token address\n     * @param principalDeposited Actual amount deposited (after fees)\n     * @param yieldMode The yield configuration\n     */\n    event YieldInitialized(\n        uint256 indexed escrowId,\n        address indexed token,\n        uint256 principalDeposited,\n        YieldPreset yieldMode\n    );\n    \n    /**\n     * @notice Emitted when yield is withdrawn\n     * @param escrowId The escrow identifier\n     * @param token The token address\n     * @param principalOut Principal amount withdrawn\n     * @param yieldOut Yield amount accrued\n     */\n    event YieldWithdrawn(\n        uint256 indexed escrowId,\n        address indexed token,\n        uint256 principalOut,\n        uint256 yieldOut\n    );\n    \n    /**\n     * @notice Emitted on emergency recovery\n     * @param escrowId The escrow identifier\n     * @param token The token address\n     * @param recovered Amount recovered\n     * @param reason Description of recovery (e.g., \"emergency_unwind\")\n     */\n    event EmergencyUnwindExecuted(\n        uint256 indexed escrowId,\n        address indexed token,\n        uint256 recovered,\n        bytes32 reason\n    );\n}\n","keccak256":"0x55606237c1b8b84eca6dfe867aadae56198437cb1517eb683442c73fde210239","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/libraries/BondHandlingLibrary.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: DisputeEscalationLibrary {\n    /**\n     * @notice Query required appeal bond from resolution module\n     * @param resolutionModule Resolution module address\n     * @param workflowId The escrow ID\n     * @param currentLevel Current escalation level\n     * @param escrowData Encoded escrow data\n     * @return success True if query succeeded\n     * @return bondAmount Required bond amount\n }\n\n        (bondAmount, bondToken) = abi.decode(bondData, (uint256, address));\n        return (true, bondAmount, bondToken);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Validate msg.value against bond Apache-2.0\npragma solidity ^0.8.33;\n\nimport '@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol';\nimport '../shared/interfaces/IResolutionModule.sol';\nimport '../types/EscrowTypes.sol';\n\n/**\n * @title DisputeOps\n * @notice External contract for dispute escalation orchestration\n * @dev Extracted from BaseEscrow to reduce contract size (Phase 2 size optimization)\n *\n *      Key design principles (from updated plan):\n *      - Compute \u2192 Apply: Returns escalation result, BaseEscrow applies to state\n *      - No callbacks: Does not write to BaseEscrow state\n *      - Atomic: Single call computes all escalation logic\n *      - View-ish: Could be view function but module may update counters\n *\n *      Pattern:\n *      BaseEscrow calls: computeEscalation(workflowId, caller, escrowData)\n *      DisputeOps returns: (newResolver, newLevel, escalationFee)\n *      BaseEscrow applies: Updates state and collects fees\n */\ncontract DisputeOps is AccessControl {\n    // ============ Role Constants ============\n    bytes32 public constant ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT = keccak256('ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT');\n    bytes32 public constant ROLE_TIMELOCK = keccak256('ROLE_TIMELOCK');\n\n    // ============ Custom Errors ============\n    error ZeroOwner();\n    /**\n     * @notice Constructor for DisputeOps\n     * @param initialOwner Address that will receive DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (for initial setup only)\n     */\n    constructor(address initialOwner) {\n        if (initialOwner == address(0)) revert ZeroOwner();\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, initialOwner);\n        // ROLE_TIMELOCK gates registerEscrowContract(), so initialOwner must have it for initial setup.\n        _grantRole(ROLE_TIMELOCK, initialOwner);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Register an escrow contract (grants it ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT)\n     * @param escrowContract Address of the escrow contract\n     * @dev Only ROLE_TIMELOCK can register escrow contracts (governance-controlled)\n     */\n    function registerEscrowContract(address escrowContract) external onlyRole(ROLE_TIMELOCK) {\n        if (escrowContract == address(0)) revert InvalidAddress(ADDR_ESCROW_CONTRACT, escrowContract);\n        _grantRole(ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT, escrowContract);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Result of dispute opening computation\n     */\n    struct DisputeOpeningResult {\n        bool success;\n        address updatedResolver;\n        bool callIncentiveHook;\n        address incentiveModule;\n        string failureReason;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Compute dispute opening parameters\n     * @param resolutionModule Resolution module address\n     * @param incentiveModule Snapshotted incentive module address\n     * @param workflowId Escrow workflow ID\n     * @param caller Address initiating the dispute\n     * @param from Escrow sender\n     * @param to Escrow recipient\n     * @param token Escrow token\n     * @param amountAfterFee Amount in escrow\n     * @param escrowState Current escrow state\n     * @param currentResolver Current resolver address\n     * @return result Dispute opening computation result\n     */\n    function computeDisputeOpening(\n        address resolutionModule,\n        address escrowContract,\n        address incentiveModule,\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        address caller,\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        address token,\n        uint256 amountAfterFee,\n        EscrowState escrowState,\n        address currentResolver\n    ) external view onlyRole(ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT) returns (DisputeOpeningResult memory result) {\n        result.success = false;\n\n        if (escrowState != EscrowState.PENDING) {\n            result.failureReason = 'Transfer not pending';\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        if (caller != from && caller != to) {\n            result.failureReason = 'Caller not participant';\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        result.updatedResolver = currentResolver;\n        if (resolutionModule != address(0) && resolutionModule.code.length > 0) {\n            bytes memory escrowData = abi.encode(token, from, to, amountAfterFee);\n            try IResolutionModule(resolutionModule).getDisputeResolver(workflowId, escrowContract, escrowData) returns (\n                address updated,\n                uint8 /* level */\n            ) {\n                if (updated != address(0)) result.updatedResolver = updated;\n            } catch {}\n        }\n\n        result.incentiveModule = incentiveModule;\n        result.callIncentiveHook = (incentiveModule != address(0));\n        result.success = true;\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Result of escalation computation\n     */\n    struct EscalationResult {\n        bool success; // Whether escalation is allowed\n        address newResolver; // New dispute resolver address\n        uint8 newLevel; // New escalation level\n        uint8 currentLevel; // Current escalation level (for event)\n        uint256 bondAmount; // Total bond amount required\n        address bondToken; // Token for the bond (address(0) for ETH)\n        address incentiveModule; // Incentive module for this escrow\n        uint256 bondToRecord; // Net bond amount after fee\n        uint256 protocolFeeAmount; // Fee collected by protocol\n        string failureReason; // Reason if escalation not allowed\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Compute escalation for a disputed escrow\n     * @param resolutionModule Address of the resolution module\n     * @param incentiveModule Snapshotted incentive module address\n     * @param bondFeeBps Snapshotted protocol fee for bonds in basis points\n     * @param feeRecipient Protocol fee recipient address\n     * @param workflowId Escrow workflow ID\n     * @param caller Address initiating the escalation (msg.sender from BaseEscrow)\n     * @param from Escrow sender address\n     * @param to Escrow recipient address\n     * @param token Token address\n     * @param amountAfterFee Amount after fee deduction (what's actually held in escrow)\n     * @param escrowState Current escrow state\n     * @return result Escalation computation result\n     */\n    function computeEscalation(\n        address resolutionModule,\n        address escrowContract,\n        address incentiveModule,\n        uint256 bondFeeBps,\n        address feeRecipient,\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        address caller,\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        address token,\n        uint256 amountAfterFee,\n        EscrowState escrowState\n    ) external view onlyRole(ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT) returns (EscalationResult memory result) {\n        result.success = false;\n\n        // Validate caller is participant\n        if (caller != from && caller != to) {\n            result.failureReason = 'Caller not participant';\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        // Validate state is DISPUTED\n        if (escrowState != EscrowState.DISPUTED) {\n            result.failureReason = 'Not in disputed state';\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        // Validate module exists\n        if (resolutionModule == address(0)) {\n            result.failureReason = 'Resolution module not configured';\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        // Encode escrow data for module\n        bytes memory escrowData = abi.encode(token, from, to, amountAfterFee);\n\n        // Get current level from module\n        try IResolutionModule(resolutionModule).getDisputeResolver(workflowId, escrowContract, escrowData) returns (\n            address /* currentResolver */,\n            uint8 currentLevel\n        ) {\n            result.currentLevel = currentLevel;\n        } catch {\n            result.failureReason = 'Failed to get current level';\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        // Validate only the disagreed-with participant can appeal\n        (bool decisionSuccess, bytes memory decisionData) = resolutionModule.staticcall(\n            abi.encodeWithSignature('getDecisionAtRound(uint256,address,uint8)', workflowId, escrowContract, result.currentLevel)\n        );\n        \n        if (decisionSuccess && decisionData.length >= 32) {\n            uint8 decision;\n            assembly {\n                decision := and(mload(add(decisionData, 0x20)), 0xff)\n            }\n            \n            if (decision == 1 && caller != from) { // RELEASE -> Recipient wins, Sender must appeal\n                result.failureReason = 'Only sender can appeal RELEASE decision';\n                return result;\n            } else if (decision == 2 && caller != to) { // CANCEL -> Sender wins, Recipient must appeal\n                result.failureReason = 'Only recipient can appeal CANCEL decision';\n                return result;\n            } else if (decision == 0) {\n                result.failureReason = 'No decision to appeal';\n                return result;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if escalation is allowed and get next resolver/bond\n        try IResolutionModule(resolutionModule).canEscalate(workflowId, escrowContract, result.currentLevel, escrowData)\n        returns (bool canEscalate, address nextResolver, uint256 /* dummyFee */) {\n            if (!canEscalate) {\n                result.failureReason = 'Escalation not allowed by module';\n                return result;\n            }\n            if (nextResolver == address(0)) {\n                result.failureReason = 'Escalation not allowed by module';\n                return result;\n            }\n            result.newResolver = nextResolver;\n            result.newLevel = result.currentLevel + 1;\n        } catch {\n            result.failureReason = 'Failed to check escalation eligibility';\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        // Get required appeal bond\n        try IResolutionModule(resolutionModule).getRequiredAppealBond(workflowId, escrowContract, result.currentLevel, escrowData)\n        returns (uint256 bondAmount, address bondToken) {\n            result.bondAmount = bondAmount;\n            result.bondToken = bondToken;\n        } catch {\n            result.failureReason = 'Failed to query appeal bond';\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        // Calculate fees if bond is required\n        if (result.bondAmount > 0) {\n            if (incentiveModule == address(0)) {\n                result.failureReason = 'Appeals not enabled in V1';\n                return result;\n            }\n            result.incentiveModule = incentiveModule;\n            \n            if (bondFeeBps > 0 && feeRecipient != address(0)) {\n                result.protocolFeeAmount = (result.bondAmount * bondFeeBps) / 10000;\n                result.bondToRecord = result.bondAmount - result.protocolFeeAmount;\n            } else {\n                result.bondToRecord = result.bondAmount;\n            }\n        }\n\n        result.success = true;\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Validate escalation fee payment\n     * @param requiredFee Fee required by escalation\n     * @param paidFee Fee actually paid (msg.value)\n     * @return valid Whether payment is sufficient\n     * @return excessRefund Amount to refund to caller\n     * @dev Helper function for BaseEscrow to validate fee payment\n     */\n    function validateEscalationFee(\n        uint256 requiredFee,\n        uint256 paidFee\n    ) external pure returns (bool valid, uint256 excessRefund) {\n        if (requiredFee > 0 && paidFee < requiredFee) {\n            return (false, 0);\n        }\n\n        valid = true;\n        if (paidFee > requiredFee) {\n            excessRefund = paidFee - requiredFee;\n        }\n        return (valid, excessRefund);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Encode escrow data for resolution module\n     * @param token Token address\n     * @param from Sender address\n     * @param to Recipient address\n     * @param amountAfterFee Amount after fee deduction (what's actually held in escrow)\n     * @return Encoded escrow data\n     * @dev Public helper for encoding - can be used by BaseEscrow or externally\n     */\n    function encodeEscrowData(\n        address token,\n        address from,\n        address to,\n        uint256 amountAfterFee\n    ) external pure returns (bytes memory) {\n        return abi.encode(token, from, to, amountAfterFee);\n    }\n\n}\n","keccak256":"0x3947ae2926f178ae577f4c650323de78b96e5af47fa827a0f693b94c4ea302ba","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/ops/SettlementOps.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\npragma solidity ^0.8.33;\n\nimport '@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol';\nimport '../shared/interfaces/IResolutionModule.sol';\nimport '../types/EscrowTypes.sol';\n\n/**\n * @title SettlementOps\n * @notice External contract for settlement execution operations\n * @dev Extracted from BaseEscrow to reduce contract size\n *\n *      Key design principles:\n *      - Compute \u2192 Apply: Returns settlement result, BaseEscrow applies to state\n *      - No callbacks: Does not write to BaseEscrow state\n *      - View-ish: Could be view functions but may query modules\n *\n *      Pattern:\n *      BaseEscrow calls: executeResolution(...) or executePendingSettlement(...)\n *      SettlementOps returns: (shouldExecute, isRelease, appealDeadline, isFinalRound)\n *      BaseEscrow applies: Updates state and executes transfer\n */\ncontract SettlementOps is AccessControl {\n    // ============ Role Constants ============\n    bytes32 public constant ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT = keccak256('ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT');\n    bytes32 public constant ROLE_TIMELOCK = keccak256('ROLE_TIMELOCK');\n\n    // ============ Custom Errors ============\n    error ZeroOwner();\n    // PendingSettlement struct (matches BaseEscrow.PendingSettlement)\n    // Note: This must match BaseEscrow.PendingSettlement exactly\n    struct SettlementPendingSettlement {\n        bool exists;\n        bool isRelease;\n        uint256 appealDeadline;\n        bytes32 resolutionHash;\n    }\n    /**\n     * @dev Result of resolution execution computation\n     */\n    struct ResolutionResult {\n        bool shouldExecute; // Whether resolution should execute immediately\n        bool isRelease; // True to release, false to cancel\n        uint256 appealDeadline; // Appeal deadline timestamp (0 if immediate)\n        bool isFinalRound; // Whether this is the final round (no appeal window)\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Constructor for SettlementOps\n     * @param initialOwner Address that will receive DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (for initial setup only)\n     */\n    constructor(address initialOwner) {\n        if (initialOwner == address(0)) revert ZeroOwner();\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, initialOwner);\n        // ROLE_TIMELOCK gates registerEscrowContract(), so initialOwner must have it for initial setup.\n        _grantRole(ROLE_TIMELOCK, initialOwner);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Register an escrow contract (grants it ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT)\n     * @param escrowContract Address of the escrow contract\n     * @dev Only ROLE_TIMELOCK can register escrow contracts (governance-controlled)\n     */\n    function registerEscrowContract(address escrowContract) external onlyRole(ROLE_TIMELOCK) {\n        if (escrowContract == address(0)) revert InvalidAddress(ADDR_ESCROW_CONTRACT, escrowContract);\n        _grantRole(ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT, escrowContract);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Action plan for settlement automation\n     * @dev Returned by computeNextAction() to guide BaseEscrow._applyActionPlan()\n     */\n    struct ActionPlan {\n        uint8 action; // 0 = none, 1 = release, 2 = cancel, 3 = set pending\n        bool isRelease; // If action == 3 (set pending)\n        uint256 appealDeadline; // If action == 3\n        bytes32 resolutionHash; // If action == 3\n        bool needsFinalization; // Whether to call finalizeDispute on resolution module\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Compute resolution execution parameters\n     * @param resolutionModule Address of the resolution module\n     * @param workflowId Escrow workflow ID\n     * @param isRelease True to release to recipient, false to cancel/refund to sender\n     * @param timeoutConfig Global timeout configuration\n     * @return result Resolution execution result\n     * @dev This function is \"compute-only\" - it does NOT modify BaseEscrow state.\n     *      BaseEscrow will apply the result after receiving it.\n     *      Only authorized escrow contracts can call this function\n     */\n    function computeResolutionExecution(\n        address resolutionModule,\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        bool isRelease,\n        TimeoutConfig memory timeoutConfig\n    ) external view onlyRole(ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT) returns (ResolutionResult memory result) {\n        result.isRelease = isRelease;\n        result.shouldExecute = false;\n        result.appealDeadline = 0;\n        result.isFinalRound = false;\n\n        // Query appeal deadline from resolution module\n        // For DecentralizedResolutionModule, this is stored in DisputeMetadata.appealDeadline[currentRound]\n        // For other modules, fall back to timeoutConfig.appealWindowDuration\n        if (resolutionModule == address(0)) {\n            // No resolution module - use global appeal window duration\n            result.appealDeadline = block.timestamp + timeoutConfig.appealWindowDuration;\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        // Validate module is still a valid contract before calling\n        if (resolutionModule.code.length == 0) {\n            // Module no longer exists - fallback to global appeal window duration\n            result.appealDeadline = block.timestamp + timeoutConfig.appealWindowDuration;\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        // Try to get appeal deadline and current round from module\n        // Use staticcall to query view function\n        (bool success, bytes memory data) = resolutionModule.staticcall(\n            abi.encodeWithSignature('getAppealDeadlineAndRound(uint256,address)', workflowId, _msgSender())\n        );\n\n        if (success && data.length > 0) {\n            // Decode return values: (uint256 appealDeadline, uint8 currentRound, bool isFinalRound)\n            (result.appealDeadline, , result.isFinalRound) = abi.decode(data, (uint256, uint8, bool));\n        } else {\n            // Module doesn't support getAppealDeadlineAndRound - fallback to global config\n            result.appealDeadline = block.timestamp + timeoutConfig.appealWindowDuration;\n        }\n\n        // If final round (MAX_ROUND), execute immediately (no appeal window)\n        if (result.isFinalRound) {\n            result.shouldExecute = true;\n        } else if (result.appealDeadline == 0) {\n            // If not final and no deadline provided, use global config\n            result.appealDeadline = block.timestamp + timeoutConfig.appealWindowDuration;\n            if (result.appealDeadline == 0) {\n                result.shouldExecute = true;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Compute pending settlement execution check\n     * @param workflowId Escrow workflow ID\n     * @param pending Pending settlement data\n     * @param escrowState Current escrow state\n     * @return canExecute Whether settlement can be executed\n     * @return isRelease True if pending release, false if pending cancel\n     * @dev This function is \"compute-only\" - it does NOT modify BaseEscrow state.\n     *      Only authorized escrow contracts can call this function\n     */\n    function computePendingSettlementExecution(\n        uint256 workflowId,\n        SettlementPendingSettlement memory pending,\n        EscrowState escrowState\n    ) external view onlyRole(ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT) returns (bool canExecute, bool isRelease) {\n        // Intentionally unused (kept for interface/telemetry parity with other ops functions)\n        workflowId;\n\n        // Verify pending settlement exists\n        if (!pending.exists) {\n            return (false, false);\n        }\n\n        // Verify appeal window has expired\n        if (block.timestamp < pending.appealDeadline) {\n            return (false, false);\n        }\n\n        // Verify state is still DISPUTED (not already executed or escalated)\n        if (escrowState != EscrowState.DISPUTED) {\n            return (false, false);\n        }\n\n        return (true, pending.isRelease);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Compute timed actions (auto-release or auto-cancel)\n     * @param et Escrow transfer data\n     * @param pending Pending settlement data\n     * @return actionType 0 = none, 1 = auto-release, 2 = auto-cancel, 3 = pending settlement\n     * @return isRelease True if release action, false if cancel\n     * @dev This function is \"compute-only\" - it does NOT modify BaseEscrow state.\n     *      Only authorized escrow contracts can call this function\n     */\n    function computeTimedActions(\n        uint256 /* workflowId */,\n et.escrowState == EscrowState.DISPUTED\n        ) {\n            return (3, pending.isRelease);\n        }\n\n        // Check for auto-release/auto-cancel (only for PENDING state)\n        if (et.escrowState != EscrowState.PENDING) {\n            return (0, false);\n        }\n\n        if (et.autoReleaseTime > 0 && block.timestamp >= et.autoReleaseTime) {\n            return (1, true);\n }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xa6ba6f5ccf5e684f13e226501d9bdd929da33678d7c46d2a7bfa4f2b6c682389","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/ops/YieldOps.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\npragma devdoc.details: This contract is the "slow lane" state holder for protocol configuration. Design / responsibilities: - Owns all queue/activate pending state (value + eta) per escrow contract. - Enforces the Slow Lane delay via `SlowLaneQueueActivate`. - Applies activated values by calling minimal setter functions on the target escrow contract. Intended integration pattern: - Governance (TimelockController) calls `queueX(escrowContract, ...)`. - After the slow delay elapses, governance calls `activateX(escrowContract)`. - The escrow contract must be compatible with `BaseEscrow` and expose the relevant setters. Important: role wiring prerequisite: - The target escrow contract must authorize this admin contract to call its setter functions. - In this codebase that is typically done via a dedicated role like `ROLE_ADMIN_CONTRACT`. - If the escrow contract has NOT granted the required role(s) to this contract, activate calls will revert.

AccessControlBadConfirmation().details: The caller of a function is not the expected one. NOTE: Don't confuse with {AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount}.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted to signal this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call. This account bears the admin role (for the granted role). Expected in cases where the role was granted using the internal {AccessControl-_grantRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

activateAppealBondProtocolFeeBps(address.details: Activates after timelock delay. Requires ROLE_TIMELOCK.      Reverts if no value is queued, or if the ETA has not passed yet. Role wiring: - The target escrow contract must grant this admin contract whatever role gates `setAppealBondProtocolFeeBps`.

activateEscrowFee(address).details: Activates after timelock delay. Requires ROLE_TIMELOCK.      Reverts if no value is queued, or if the ETA has not passed yet. Role wiring: - The target escrow contract must grant this admin contract whatever role gates `setEscrowFeeBps`.

activateFeeRecipient(address).details: Activates after timelock delay. Requires ROLE_TIMELOCK.      Reverts if no value is queued, or if the ETA has not passed yet. Role wiring: - The target escrow contract must grant this admin contract whatever role gates `setFeeRecipient`.

activateResolutionModule(address).details: Activates after timelock delay. Requires ROLE_TIMELOCK.      Reverts if no value is queued, or if the ETA has not passed yet. Role wiring: - The target escrow contract must grant this admin contract whatever role gates `setResolutionModule`.

activateYieldProtocolFeeBps(address).details: Activates after timelock delay. Requires ROLE_TIMELOCK.      Reverts if no value is queued, or if the ETA has not passed yet. Role wiring: - The target escrow contract must grant this admin contract whatever role gates `setYieldProtocolFeeBps`.

constructor.details: Grants `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` and `ROLE_TIMELOCK` to `initialOwner` for initial setup.      In production, `ROLE_TIMELOCK` should be granted to the TimelockController and      `initialOwner` should have its roles revoked as part of deployment hardening.

params.initialOwner: Initial admin for bootstrap (expected to be replaced/managed by governance wiring).

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

queueAppealBondProtocolFeeBps(address,ui.details: Uses slow lane activation pattern. Requires ROLE_TIMELOCK.

queueEscrowFee(address,uint256).details: Uses slow lane activation pattern. Requires ROLE_TIMELOCK.      For launch, the max fee is capped at 200 bps (2%).

queueFeeRecipient(address,address).details: Uses slow lane activation pattern. Requires ROLE_TIMELOCK.      Reverts if `newAddr` is invalid per `SlowLaneQueueActivate` rules.

params.newAddr: New fee recipient address to queue

queueResolutionModule(address,address).details: Uses slow lane activation pattern. Requires ROLE_TIMELOCK.

params.module: Address of the new resolution module to queue

queueYieldProtocolFeeBps(address,uint256.details: Uses slow lane activation pattern. Requires ROLE_TIMELOCK.

registerEscrowContract(address).details: This grants the escrow contract `ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT` in this admin contract.      Registration is governance-controlled (`ROLE_TIMELOCK`). Note: registration is informational/allowlisting for offchain consumers; queue/activate functions do not currently check `ROLE_ESCROW_CONTRACT`.

params.escrowContract: Address of the escrow contract to register.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setTimeoutConfig(address,(uint256,uint25.details: Validates all fields and updates atomically. Requires ROLE_TIMELOCK. Role wiring: - The target escrow contract must grant this admin contract whatever role gates `setTimeoutConfig`.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.
